def calculate_age(start_date, end_date):
    age = (end_date.year - start_date.year) + (end_date.month - start_date.month) // 12 + (end_date.day - start_date.day) // 30
    if end_date > start_date:
        age += (end_date.year - start_date.year) // 4
    if start_date.month == end_date.month and start_date.day == end_date.day:
        return 0
    else:
